title: Easy Spinach and Cheese Lasagne
subtitle: with ricotta, cottage cheese and mozzarella
description: Layers of lightly sauteed spinach and a simple cheese mixture between lasagne sheets, with only 5 minutes of assembly.

steps.text: Heat a little olive oil in a frying pan. Saute the roughly chopped spinach until wilted. Add the crushed garlic and let it cool slightly.
In a large bowl, mix the ricotta, cottage cheese, cooking cream, eggs, half the mozzarella, half the parmesan and the spinach. Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Spread a thin layer of the mixture on the base of a baking dish. Top with lasagne sheets, then a layer of the cheese and spinach mixture. Repeat until the filling is used up.
Sprinkle the remaining mozzarella and parmesan on top.
Cover with foil and bake for about 40 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for another 20 minutes, until nicely golden.
Let the lasagne rest for 10 minutes before cutting so it sets.
